name: Fuentidueña (Spain)
description: Square flag vertically divided, the hoist red with a white crescent above a white lower third, the fly blue with a yellow wall with gate above a yellow fountain.
history: Fuentidueña adopted its arms and flag officially on 25 September 2014, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 11 March 2015; the flag is a cloth of proportions 1/1, parted vertically, at the hoist on a red field a silver crescent and the lower third silver, at the fly on a blue field a wall with a gate.

features.role: crescent with its horns downward on the red
lower third of the hoist half
wall with a gate above a fountain
